metadata.artifact_title: DeepSeek Harness ADR-08: Base/Extended Staging Architecture
metadata.source_title: Shi, Zhang, and Cui, A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability

decision.base_relation_role: Rb is a derived AtomicProfile-controlled macro/view and H04 R.base remains SUBSUMED/specialization
rationale: Extended lifecycle rules expose Reloading and Unloading intermediate states.
Base L-Reload expands to L-Begin followed by L-Finish.
Base L-Unload expands to L-Leave followed by L-Unload.
Filtering R+ by stable endpoints loses required lifecycle steps or admits unrelated paths.
decision.non_claim: This packet does not claim full BD-STAGING closure, concrete K proofs, guard/WF preservation, or runtime refinement.

relations.base_orchestration: Rb_orch l b b' := AtomicProfile.orch l and Trace (fun a => R+_orch a) (embed b) (expandOrch l) (embed b')
relations.base_lifecycle: Rb_life l b b' := AtomicProfile.life l and Trace (fun a => R+_life a) (embed b) (expandLife l) (embed b')
relations.optional_stuttering: A profile may explicitly admit b = b' as a tagged no-op branch; failure and unfinished paths are never stuttering successes.
relations.relation_classes: Orchestration and lifecycle remain separate projections; ADR-07 may package them as a typed sum.

laws: forall b, project (embed b) = some b
embedding_projection.converse_not_assumed: project x = some b does not globally imply x = embed b; canonicalization is an optional concrete profile law.

atomic_profile.purpose: Specify which finite full paths denote one atomic base action.
required_fields: finite ordered expansion list for every base label
atomicity predicate on the expansion list
no unaccounted yield, raise, or asynchronous landing branch

L-Reload.profile_condition: committed target, finite iterator stage, no interleaving or failure

L-Unload.profile_condition: retirement/withdrawal guard, finite path, no interleaving or failure

finite_toy_checks: wrong stable endpoint is rejected for O-Insert
an extra/interleaved lifecycle label is rejected by toyAtomicLife
a failure label is rejected by toyAtomicLife
the fixed L-Begin/L-Finish path has an explicit atomic adequacy witness

forward_simulation.orchestration: Rb_orch l b b' implies Trace (fun a => R+_orch a) (embed b) (expandOrch l) (embed b')
forward_simulation.lifecycle: Rb_life l b b' implies Trace (fun a => R+_life a) (embed b) (expandLife l) (embed b')
forward_simulation.trace_composition: base trace concatenation maps to full trace concatenation via Trace.append
forward_simulation.endpoint_requirement: The endpoint embedding and ordered labels are part of the witness; endpoint equality alone is insufficient.

atomic_adequacy_stuttering_converse.premise: AtomicProfile-accepted full path between embedded stable endpoints, with no interleaving/failure/pending branch
atomic_adequacy_stuttering_converse.conclusion: corresponding base label plus expansion witness, or an explicitly permitted stuttering identity
atomic_adequacy_stuttering_converse.scope: Not a classifier for arbitrary full traces.

only_under: complete atomic partition for the considered full lifecycle paths
no pending in-flight or failure branch at the endpoint
matching guard, provider, and WellFormed premises
quiescence_bridge.outside_profile: quietBase is not a shortcut for full quiescence.

ownership.R+_labels_and_control: ADR-07/control; this packet consumes the interface
ownership.support_confluence_runtime: ADR-09 support packet and later phases; not a dependency of ADR-08

boundaries.adapter: STC.Adapter remains the one-way abstraction/refinement seam.

relation_to_h04.R.base: SUBSUMED/specialization via derived macro/view and simulation
relation_to_h04.R.full: single authoritative labelled relation; no duplicate base relation

remaining_blockers: BD-CONTROL concrete rules and landing policy

acceptance_checks: R+ is the sole authoritative full relation.
Rb is defined only through an AtomicProfile-controlled finite macro/view.
embed/project round-trip and stable-image laws are explicit.
ForwardSimulation and AtomicAdequacy/stuttering-converse interfaces are explicit.
No full BD-STAGING, concrete K, guard, WF, or runtime claim is made.

local_checks: no sorry/admit/project axiom/unsafe lexical markers in spike

integrity.hash_policy: SHA-256 covers companion bytes; JSON self-hash is intentionally excluded and remains null.
